LanguageData.PhobosWaterTap_Keeps: Keeps {COUNT} bottles ready. Each bottle uses {WATER} L of water.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterTap_MapStock: Bottles on this map: {COUNT} of {LIMIT} (colony limit).
LanguageData.PhobosWaterTap_StateSwitchedOff: Switched off: it's set to keep 0 bottles.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterTap_StateFull: Full. It fills again when a bottle is taken.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterTap_StateStockLimit: Not filling: this map has reached its colony limit. It fills again when the stock falls below the limit.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterTap_StateBlocked: Waiting: another item is on the tap. Have it moved.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterTap_StateNoWaterTower: Waiting for water: no water tower on this pipe network. Connect it to your plumbing.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterTap_StateContaminated: Stopped: the water in these pipes is contaminated. Clear the contaminated water tower.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterTap_StateDry: Waiting for water: the water towers on this pipe network are empty.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterTap_StateDifferentWater: Waiting for these bottles to be taken: the water in the pipes has changed, and different water doesn't go in the same stack.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterTap_LessDesc: Keep one bottle fewer ready at this tap. At 0 the tap stops filling. Bottles already here stay until someone takes them.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterTap_MoreDesc: Keep one bottle more ready at this tap, up to {LIMIT}.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterTap_AlreadyOff: This tap is already set to keep 0 bottles.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterTap_AlreadyFull: This tap can't keep more than {LIMIT}: that is one stack of water, and it holds one stack.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterTap_TargetChanged: This tap now keeps {COUNT} bottles ready.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterTap_LimitDesc: Every tap on this map stops filling once the map holds this many bottles. It's now {LIMIT}. This counts bottles in storage or on the floor, not in colonists' pockets or riding on conveyor belts. It's one number for the whole map, whichever tap you change it from. At 0 no tap on this map fills.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterTap_LimitAtLowest: The colony limit is already 0: no tap on this map fills.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterTap_LimitAtHighest: The colony limit can't go above {LIMIT}.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterTap_LimitChanged: Taps on this map now stop filling at {LIMIT} bottles.
